name: graaf
description: Jt de Graaf's agent skills: house style, architecture guidelines per stack, and app-shipping workflows.

plugins.name: house-style
plugins.description: Language-agnostic house style: flat control flow, rare short comments, coded errors, no silent defaults, deliberate tests.

plugins.name: spring-slices
plugins.description: Spring Boot backends as DDD feature slices: thin controllers, services own the flow, domain owns invariants.

plugins.name: react-slices
plugins.description: React + TypeScript SPAs by responsibility: thin routes, feature slices, generated API client, components that only render.

plugins.name: godot-netplay
plugins.description: Multiplayer games: an engine-free .NET host library plus a Godot C# client that only renders and wires.

plugins.name: launchpad
plugins.description: Ship a frontend-only app from one prompt: idea, unique design, GitHub repo, Cloudflare deploy on <slug>.graaf.dev.

plugins.name: orchestrator
plugins.description: An improvement loop for a deployed app: a scout files GitHub issues, one visible session per issue fixes and ships it, repeat.
